text1: A rare and ancient hull which possesses unusually advanced technology for its age. Its history is shrouded in secrecy, but it is said to have once been used by a brotherhood of genetically enhanced warriors known only as the Angels of Death.

This ship has been given Luddic Church markings, and certain heretical technologies have been stripped out.
